actions.title: Call free legal aid
actions.reason: Your court date is in 7 days (Oct 17, 2026). A lawyer can check for defenses, errors in the filing, and options like a consent agreement.

actions.title: Ask legal aid about a move-out agreement
actions.reason: Your case is in court. How it ends can affect your ability to rent again.

actions.title: Gather documents for your hearing
actions.reason: Your court date is in 7 days (Oct 17, 2026). Judges decide based on what's in front of them, so bring proof.

actions.title: Still go to your court date
actions.reason: Missing court risks an adverse judgment even while you plan a move.

actions.title: Make sure you have a safe place to stay
actions.reason: Staying in your current home may not be possible, so it's important to know your backup options.

actions.title: Start your affordable housing search
actions.reason: Starting early gives you more choices.

actions.title: Ask for deposit and move-in help
actions.reason: Move-in costs are often the biggest barrier to a new place.

actions.title: Line up moving and furniture help
actions.reason: Planning the move early avoids losing belongings.

actions.title: Keep your children's school and care stable
actions.reason: You have children. Ask the school liaison whether your living situation qualifies for McKinney-Vento protections and school-stability support.

actions.title: Strengthen your income
actions.reason: Your income recently dropped. Rebuilding it makes your next home more stable.

actions.title: Lock in benefits during the transition
actions.reason: Benefits keep basics covered while your housing changes.

actions.title: Keep copies of everything
actions.reason: Written records protect you in court and make assistance applications faster.
